title: Optic Bench
summary: Benchmark CPU, RAM, storage, 2D and GPU, and compare on a shared board.
description:
Optic Bench measures how fast your CardputerZero is and gives it a score you can compare.

- CPU: six tests on one thread and on all four (compression, SHA-256, sorting, Mandelbrot, n-body, pointer chasing).
- RAM: fill, copy and random-read latency.
- Storage: sequential read and write and random 4K reads on your card.
- 2D: LVGL drawing off-screen and on the device's own panel.
- GPU: an OpenGL ES 2 scene through the VC4 driver, when the driver is present.

A score of 1000 means as fast as the reference CardputerZero. Each result keeps the temperature, load and throttling state it was measured in, so you can tell a fair run from a hot one. Past results are kept on the device.

You can share a result to the public board under a name you choose and see how other units did. Sharing is optional; a run takes about 100 seconds and nothing is sent unless you share. Sharing uses curl.
